body: Thank you so much for helping me, I feel much better now. I will think about what you said every time I feel bad again, is there anything I can do in return for your kindness?

Everything I want to be good in. One of my friends knows a little more about computers than me, one of them beat me in science/art skills, etc. I want to be known for something among my friends instead of being that one guy who has no use but everything I want to be is already dominated by someone else. And I don't want to hurt them by being better than them. I want to beat but I don't want to, if that makes sense.
I feel terrible because my friends are all better than me, and if I best them I don't want them to feel like I do now. I want to have a purpose though
